name: Self-employed Visa (Cuenta Propia / Autónomo)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a business plan (activity, planned investment, expected returns, jobs to be created) submitted in Spanish.
requirements.fix_path: Develop and translate a business plan meeting the required content.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires proof of professional qualification relevant to the planned activity.
This requires sufficient economic means to cover maintenance and accommodation for the first year, after deducting projected business costs.

evidence_required.document: Business plan in Spanish (activity, investment, expected returns, job creation)
RETA (self-employed Social Security) registration within 1 month of entry

sources.title: BOE — Real Decreto 1155/2024 (Reglamento de Extranjería), Arts. 82-85

notes: GENUINE PROCESS IMPROVEMENT confirmed for the 20 May 2025 reform: business-plan scrutiny was materially softened — offices now weight prior experience/training more heavily, accept plans reviewed by professional associations (UPTA/ATA) as pre-vetted, and allow a subsanación (correction) window instead of outright denial for a deficient plan. The same reform also newly permits holding cuenta propia and cuenta ajena status SIMULTANEOUSLY — a genuine flexibility not present in the prior reglamento and worth surfacing, since it means someone can be self-employed and take on employed work without switching routes entirely. Initial permit is geographically and sector-limited (tied to the specific business plan and location) — a real constraint not present on the equivalent UK/German/Dutch self-employment routes, worth flagging in a comparison view. RETA registration deadline (1 month after entry) is a hard operational deadline distinct from the visa/permit timeline itself, easy to miss and genuinely consequential.
